purpose: Measure the actual combinatorial scale and classical solver hardness of the frozen Stage72 k=3 constraint-native receptor-selection objectives before authorizing any larger-k, cloud, or quantum-hardware study.

scaling_workloads.nested_pool_order_rule: Sort receptors by ascending frozen Stage72 integer quality deficit, then SHA-256 of receptor_id, then receptor_id. Do not use objective value, selected subset, validation performance, or test data to define a pool.
scaling_workloads.frozen_quality_floor_rule: Use the exact Stage72 maximum integer deficit D.
scaling_workloads.relaxed_quality_floor_rule: Use max(D, the smallest deterministic integer threshold containing at least ceil(0.10*choose(n,k)) fixed-k states).
scaling_workloads.no_quality_floor_rule: Use the maximum deficit sum among all fixed-k states in the nested pool.

solver_protocol.fixed_cardinality_neighborhood: one selected receptor out and one unselected receptor in
solver_protocol.oracle_feasible_initialization_interpret: Budgeted stochastic methods sample initial states from the independently enumerated feasible set. Results therefore measure optimization conditional on feasibility, not end-to-end CQM feasibility discovery.
solver_protocol.decision_metric: deterministic proposal and objective-evaluation counts; wall-clock runtime is descriptive only and is excluded from route decisions

benchmark_gate.interpretation: Passing this gate establishes that the current k=3 workload is classically tractable and that the local constraint-native protocol is ready to be scaled. It authorizes only a preregistered larger-k or variable-k benchmark, never a quantum advantage claim or direct hardware execution.

interpretation_boundary: Stage73 is a post-hoc classical solver-scaling diagnostic on four consumed historical development targets and the frozen Stage72 k=3 objective. It does not measure screening efficacy, independent-target generalization, physical embedding, QPU sampling, cloud-hybrid performance, wall-clock speedup, quantum scaling, or quantum advantage.
